title: Diagnosing with Insights: Structured Analysis of Agent Failures via Behavioral Abstractions
abstract: arXiv:2609.02371v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: With the proliferation of LLM agents, the ability to understand and diagnose failures in agents is essential to achieving superior effectiveness and trustworthiness. As agent failures often manifest via long and complex trajectories, manually finding the needles in the haystack is untenable. However, traditional diagnosis techniques for software bugs can hardly address LLM agent failures, while completely relying on LLMs as the judge yields unreliable diagnosis results. To overcome these challenges, this paper presents AGENTSCOPE, a new neuro-symbolic approach for agent failure mode diagnosis. The key principle of AGENTSCOPE is to abstract agent behavior, based on its trajectories, into structured representations. Furthermore, AGENTSCOPE introduces the concept of neural invariants to specify agent behavior properties. translated_title: 基于洞察的诊断：通过行为抽象对智能体故障进行结构化分析
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）智能体的大量涌现，理解和诊断智能体故障的能力对于实现卓越的有效性和可信度至关重要。由于智能体故障通常通过漫长而复杂的轨迹表现出来，人工在其中大海捞针般地寻找问题根源是行不通的。然而，传统的软件缺陷诊断技术难以应对LLM智能体故障，而完全依赖LLM作为评判者则会产生不可靠的诊断结果。为了克服这些挑战，本文提出了AGENTSCOPE，一种用于智能体故障模式诊断的新型神经符号方法。AGENTSCOPE的关键原则是将智能体行为（基于其轨迹）抽象为结构化表示。此外，AGENTSCOPE引入了神经不变式（neural invariants）的概念来规约智能体行为属性。AGENTSCOPE利用LLM引导的推理，在结构化表示之上对照神经不变式来精确定位……
tldr: 本文提出AGENTSCOPE，一种神经符号方法，通过将智能体轨迹抽象为结构化表示并引入神经不变式概念，结合LLM引导的推理来可靠且精确地诊断智能体的故障模式。
en_tdlr: This paper presents AGENTSCOPE, a neuro-symbolic approach that reliably diagnoses agent failure modes by abstracting agent trajectories into structured representations and introducing neural invariants, leveraging LLM-guided reasoning to pinpoint failures.
